```{=html}
<div class="subscribe" id="theil-subscribe">
  <div class="sub-text"><b>Stay informed.</b> Receive the news and blog posts of THEILUMINA by email, or follow the <a href="https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/theilumina/blog/index.xml">RSS feed</a>.</div>
  <form class="sub-form" id="sub-form" method="post" target="_blank">
    <input type="email" name="email" class="form-control" placeholder="Your email" required aria-label="Your email">
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Subscribe</button>
  </form>
  <p class="sub-note">You can unsubscribe at any time. Your email is used only to send THEILUMINA news.</p>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  // Optional: username of a free Buttondown newsletter (https://buttondown.com). Empty = subscription by email to the team.
  const BUTTONDOWN_USER = "";
  const CONTACT_EMAIL = "jfmunoz@ugr.es";
  const f = document.getElementById("sub-form");
  if (!f) return;
  if (BUTTONDOWN_USER) {
    f.action = `https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/${BUTTONDOWN_USER}`;
  } else {
    f.addEventListener("submit", e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = f.querySelector("input").value.trim();
      const body = `Please subscribe this email address to THEILUMINA news: ${email}`;
      window.location.href = `mailto:${CONTACT_EMAIL}?subject=${encodeURIComponent("[THEILUMINA] Subscribe to news")}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
    });
  }
  if (window.goatcounter) f.addEventListener("submit", () => window.goatcounter.count && window.goatcounter.count({path: "subscribe", title: "Newsletter subscription", event: true}));
})();
</script>
```
